en: A sepia-toned postcard showing an elegant neoclassical interior with a colonnaded gallery surrounding an open atrium. Massive stone columns with ornate Corinthian capitals support arches and a coffered glass roof. Balustrades run along the edges of the gallery, and a large painting is visible on the far wall. On the right side is a printed caption in multiple languages identifying the location and publisher.
